description: Bring records in from a CSV, TSV or Excel (.xlsx) file.

headings.preview: Check how the file is read

menu.appendDenied: You cannot add records to this table.
menu.createDenied: Only base admins can create tables.

upload.drop: Drop a file here, or choose one
upload.limits: CSV, TSV or Excel (.xlsx), up to {{size}} MB and {{rows}} rows.

problems.tooLarge: The file is larger than {{size}} MB. Split it into smaller files.
problems.unsupported: {{name}} is not a CSV, TSV or Excel (.xlsx) file.
problems.legacyExcel: {{name}} is an older spreadsheet format. Save it as Excel Workbook (.xlsx) or CSV, then import it.

preview.headerRow: The first row holds column names
preview.caption: First {{shown}} of {{total}} rows

mapping.tableNameTaken: A table with this name already exists in this base.
mapping.createHint: Each imported column becomes a field. Types are guessed from the first 200 rows; values that do not fit a field's type are skipped and listed in the report.
mapping.appendHint: Choose the field each column fills. Only fields you can write are offered; columns left out are not imported.
mapping.primaryText: The primary field is always text.
mapping.fieldNameDuplicate: Another column already has this name.
mapping.noColumns: Choose at least one column to import.
mapping.duplicateField: This field is already filled by another column.
mapping.missingRequired: Required fields without a column: {{fields}}. Every row would be skipped.
mapping.nothingMapped: No column is mapped to a field yet.

status.mappedLink: Fills {{field}} by record title; separate several titles with commas, quote a title that has a comma
status.mappedParent: Fills {{field}} with the parent record of that title
status.unsupported: Not imported: {{field}} holds files, which cannot be imported
status.computed: Not imported: {{field}} is calculated by a formula or lookup
status.noMatch: Not imported: no field with this name

mapping.filesNote_one: {{fields}} holds files: files cannot be imported from a sheet. Add them in the grid after the import.
mapping.filesNote_other: {{fields}} hold files: files cannot be imported from a sheet. Add them in the grid after the import.

titles.heading: Columns filled by record titles
titles.parent: {{column}} → {{field}}: title of the parent record in {{table}}
titles.exact: A title is the primary field of a record, written exactly, and must match one record you can see (and the field’s condition, if any).
titles.separator: Several records: separate the titles with commas. Put a title that has a comma between double quotes, e.g. An Phát, "Nguyễn, An".
titles.parentRule: One parent title per cell; the parent must exist before the import (not a row of the same file).
titles.skipped: A row whose title matches no record, or several, is skipped and listed in the error report.

run.queued: Waiting for another import of your organization to finish…
run.background: You can close this window: the import goes on and a notification shows when it is done.
run.confirmAppend: Rows already imported stay in the table.
run.confirmCreate: The new table and the rows already imported go to the trash.

result.partial: The import finished, but some rows were skipped.
result.moreErrors: The first {{shown}} problems are listed here; the report has all of them.
result.reportGone: The error report is no longer available.
result.truncated: The report holds the first 100,000 problems only.
result.cancelledAppend: Rows imported before cancelling stay in the table.
result.cancelledCreate: The new table was moved to the trash; you can restore it for 30 days.
result.failedAppend: Rows imported before the problem stay in the table.
result.failedCreate: The new table was moved to the trash.
result.reportHint: The report lists every skipped row with the value that was refused. Only you can download it.
result.linkSummaryAmbiguous_one: {{formatted}} linked record with a title several records share.
result.linkSummaryAmbiguous_other: {{formatted}} linked records with a title several records share.
result.linkSummary_one: {{count, number}} linked record not matched: {{notFound}} not found, {{ambiguous}} with a title several records share.
result.linkSummary_other: {{count, number}} linked records not matched: {{notFound}} not found, {{ambiguous}} with a title several records share.

linkFix.LINK_TARGET_NOT_FOUND: Check the spelling against the record’s primary field; records you cannot see, or outside the field’s condition, do not match.
linkFix.LINK_TARGET_AMBIGUOUS: Give the records different titles, or write the record id (rec_…) in the file.

leave.title: Leave the import?
leave.description: The columns you set here are lost; the file stays uploaded for 24 hours.
